name: CMN Hypha
synopsis: The reference CMN client CLI — release spores, query synapses, resolve bonds, and manage your local mycelium.
intent: Provide the reference CMN client: release signed spore manifests, query Synapse indexers for discovery, resolve bond URIs, verify content hashes, and manage the local development workflow
Enable any developer to publish, discover, and consume spores from the command line — the primary interface for interacting with the CMN network
mutations: Add mycelium spore yank/unyank for surgical single-spore lifecycle — delist a spore from the mycelium inventory by re-signing only the mycelium (not the whole graph), keeping published bytes resolvable (crates.io yank semantics) with --purge to also delete them, and restore from the kept manifest
Add a declarative hatch bond sync that reconciles the bonds of a spore to a target spec in one call — computing the add/update/remove diff internally instead of scripting individual set/remove ops
Resolve one-shot CLI exit codes the broken-pipe-safe way (afdata finish contract) — a hung-up reader exits 0 and a failed terminal write exits 4, instead of always reporting success
Hard-error on a corrupt spore.core.json instead of silently proceeding, and converge bond writes so repeated syncs are stable
Honor nested .gitignore files hierarchically during tree hashing, and validate bond directory path segments directly
Track agent-first-data 0.19.1 and adopt afslug for Unicode-aware local directory slugs

bonds.reason: Implements the CMN protocol specification — reference client CLI
All CLI output and protocol fields use Agent-First Data suffix conventions
